sloka: न तावत्कुम्भकर्णाय प्रदातव्यो वरस्त्वया ।जानीषे हि यथा लोकांस्त्रासयत्येष दुर्मतिः ।। ७.१०.३७ ॥
transliteration: na tāvatkumbhakarṇāya pradātavyo varastvayā ।jānīṣe hi yathā lokāṁstrāsayatyeṣa durmatiḥ ।। 7.10.37 ॥

translations.english: "A boon should not be granted by you to Kumbhakarna at this time, for you indeed know how this evil-minded one terrorizes the worlds."
translations.hindi: अब लोको को विकल करने वाले रावण ऑर कुम्भकश उस बन में धीरे धीरे बढ्ने लगे
